description: This file contains mixin definitions for FontAwesome icon styling, including rotation and flipping transformations, used in a CSS preprocessor environment.

methods.name: fa-icon
methods.description: Mixin for setting icon display and font properties for FontAwesome icons.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Mixin for rotating icons by specified degrees and rotation parameters.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Mixin for flipping icons horizontally and vertically, with optional rotation.
